extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: fairground bumper car (dodgem) for two, approx. 1.5 m wide, 2.1 m long, 2.7 m tall incl. pole
extras.notes: front faces -Y; rounded light blue body with cream rim and domed hood, thick dark rubber bumper all around, pink bench with backrest, steering column with steering ring, two glowing headlights ('bumper-car_lamp_bulbs', emissive, not baked), gold stars, low chassis with four small rollers and the sprung current collector pole with contact shoe at the back. No text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
